setup.command:
set -euo pipefail
if ! command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    exit 3
fi
head_commit=$(git rev-parse --verify 'HEAD^{commit}')
worktree_hash=$(
    git diff --binary --full-index --no-ext-diff --no-textconv HEAD -- |
        git hash-object --stdin
)
status_hash=$(
    git status --porcelain=v1 -z --untracked-files=all |
        git hash-object --stdin
)
index_hash=$(
    git ls-files --stage -z |
        git hash-object --stdin
)
printf 'head_commit	%s
' "$head_commit"
printf 'worktree_hash	%s
' "$worktree_hash"
printf 'status_hash	%s
' "$status_hash"
printf 'index_hash	%s
' "$index_hash"

command.command: for f in /app/src/posts/cache.js /app/src/controllers/admin/cache.js /app/src/posts/parse.js /app/src/socket.io/admin/cache.js /app/src/socket.io/admin/plugins.js /app/src/user/index.js /app/src/meta/index.js /app/src/webserver.js; do node -c "$f" && echo "$f OK"; done
